t: Who he included in his own sacrifice
a: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ هَذَا عَنِّي وَعَمَّنْ لَمْ يُضَحِّ مِنْ أُمَّتِي
p: Bismi-Llāhi wa-Llāhu akbar. Hādhā ʿannī wa ʿamman lam yuḍaḥḥi min ummatī
m: In the name of Allah, and Allah is greatest. This is from me, and from whoever of my community did not sacrifice.
